definitions.explanation: An injury that is severe and requires significant medical treatment. In Japanese legal and medical contexts, generally defined as an injury requiring more than 30 days of treatment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{重傷|じゅうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}った→負う：02017_ou⟧。
examples.english: He sustained serious injuries in the accident.

examples.japanese: {重傷|じゅうしょう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{搬送|はんそう}→搬送：24543_hansou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The seriously injured were transported to the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{別状|べつじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{重傷|じゅうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}い→負う：02017_ou⟧、⟦{入院|にゅういん}する→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Fortunately his life was not in danger, but he sustained a serious leg injury and had to be hospitalized.

notes:
{重傷|じゅうしょう} refers to physical injuries. It is commonly seen in news reports about accidents, crimes, and disasters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重傷|じゅうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧ (to sustain serious injuries)
- {重傷|じゅうしょう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (seriously injured person)
- ⟦{全治|ぜんち}→全治：28019_zenchi⟧〇⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重傷|じゅうしょう} (serious injury requiring X weeks to heal)

Distinct from ⟦{重症|じゅうしょう}→重症：09792_juushou⟧ (serious illness/condition), which is a homophone. {重傷|じゅうしょう} uses the kanji {傷|しょう} (wound/injury) and refers to physical wounds, while ⟦{重症|じゅうしょう}→重症：09792_juushou⟧ uses {症|しょう} (condition/symptom) and refers to a severe state of illness. The opposite is ⟦{軽傷|けいしょう}→軽傷：16546_keishou⟧ (minor injury).
